text:
marina: Quick heads-up — AuroraAI just forwarded an onboarding package for their open LLM (v1.2). There's a clause that looks like it blocks redistribution to cloud marketplaces. Can legal eyeball?
ajay: Can you paste the exact wording? If it's a plain 'no redistribution' it's a non-starter for marketplace listings.
marina: Sure — copied from their doc:
```
Redistribution Prohibition: Licensee shall not redistribute, sublicense, or otherwise make the Model available through third-party marketplaces, bundled offerings, or any commercial intermediary without express written permission from AuroraAI.
```
marina: They also added an export-control sentence referencing “geofencing to embargoed jurisdictions.”
ajay: Hmm. Two separate issues. Redistribution prohibition prevents us listing on public cloud marketplaces or bundling with HW partners. We can request a carve-out for 'cloud marketplace distribution' + 'SIs for integration' — typical ask.
ajay: On export controls — need specifics. If they require geofencing in perpetuity that's tougher but doable via contractual SLAs / region restrictions.
legal-bot: Automated checklist started — will run compatibility checks against Redwood Marketplace and SI distribution playbook.
tom_s: From infra side: marketplace listing needs us to host model artifacts in our storage and provide pull ACLs. If Aurora forbids redistribution, we can't host their weights and serve via our hosted API or dedicated images.
marina: Their stated intent seems to be preventing people from repackaging the weights for resale. They're OK with partners integrating via API but ambiguous about hosting.
sylvie: For joint announcement planning — we need a marketplace carve-out before announcing. Don’t want marketing to schedule anything until legal and product align.
ajay: Proposal: ask for two carve-outs: 1) Allow Redwood (and authorized channel partners/SIs) to host and distribute the model for paid marketplace listings and managed service delivery. 2) Allow automatic geo-blocking per export control laws, with Aurora providing the list of embargoed countries.
ajay: I can draft an amendment. marina — can you ask Aurora for a short statement that they permit 'commercial distribution via authorized marketplaces and systems integrators' and their export-control list and process?
marina: Will ask now. I'll attach their original license and flag the exact lines. ETA EOD PT.
tom_s: If they accept the carve-out, we should also add tech controls: signed URL expirations, object-level encryption, and usage reporting for audits.
sylvie: Also add a PR embargo clause in the amendment — 48-72h notice for any co-marketing assets.
marina: Noted. pinging them: @auroraai-ops — can you confirm whether 'redistribution' is meant to block marketplace listings and SI integrations? Also please share the export-control country list. Thanks!
ajay: Thanks — once we have their reply I'll draft the amendment and loop in compliance for export controls.
marina: Thanks all :thumbsup:
